title: asplenium radicans var. expansum
intro: Asplenium radicans var. expansum, commonly known as the maidenhair spleenwort or maidenhair fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium radicans var. expansum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may contribute to its use in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
